newsitem.title: UK: Gilts drift to lower close but mkt still volatile.
newsitem.headline: Gilts drift to lower close but mkt still volatile.

text.p: 1520 GMT - Gilts subsided into the red on Thursday, but only modestly, with global bond markets facing a whole host of factors creating uncertainty. UK trade data did little to boost the market. All eyes now on German gold, US GDP and French elections. * June gilt future settled 4/32 lower at 112-06
